reviews.body: I bought this 3 days ago from the local store. It was purple says color changing. Oh it changed color to green and hasn't gone back to purple. You should redo your package advertisement. Color changing implies plural like should change back to purple. It should say color change. Non plural. Meaning the color you chose is going to change but not change back. Also you have to re-select your temp every time you turn it on. It will not heat up unless you do. You say 3 minutes and then it shuts off. That's incorrect. I set mine on the low setting and it's off before 2 mins is up. I timed it because I thought it was weird I could only do 1 pull before it shut off. And then there's when it heats up.. do not hold it in your hand while it's heating up. It will burn you. Not bad enough for medical attention but enough to make you drop it. In my opinion you needed to test this product before releasing it. You can say you did but facts are they don't match up to what you advertise. Such a shame too. I don't recommend. 2 stars because it does fit comfy in my hand. But functional not so much.
reviews.translationZh: 我三天前在当地商店购买。紫色款宣传为会变色，后来变成绿色后没有再变回紫色，包装文案容易让人误解。每次开机都必须重新选择温度，否则不会加热；宣传称三分钟自动关机，但低档不到两分钟就关闭，只够吸一口。加热时机身烫手，足以让人松手掉落。产品与宣传不符，不推荐；给两星只是因为握持舒适。

reviews.body:
I purchased this device as an inexpensive backup to my normal dry vape, and I'm pretty happy with what the SYNDR is.  I agree with most of the comments regarding the strength of the vapor, but I believe the solution is to use the RED setting, and pack the vapor chamber so that the dry leaf is pressing against the sides as much as possible.  I was able to get quite a bit of leaf in the chamber and had no problem getting a good draw.  

I hope this helps!

One hitch- my dab piece didn't work at first, there was DUST in the threads, Just a head's up. Clean it out and re-attach.

Everything hits AMAZING! The dabs burn clean, the bucket is AMAZING and smooth- will be easy to clean. The herb burns nicely! and carts are just as expected. Overall, a bit on the pricey side- if you don't have all these options in other toys- this is a solid purchase. The best dabbing bucket Pulsar has made too! However, it seems the dabbing option ONLY has a preheat sesh- no button on demand- and that is a bummer to me. The green is too weak, the blue too hot. But the burn is so good and clean, worth it. This is my only electric vape for flower, so I'm having fun! Recommended!

rows.body: I bought this 3 days ago from the local store. It was purple says color changing. Oh it changed color to green and hasn't gone back to purple. You should redo your package advertisement. Color changing implies plural like should change back to purple. It should say color change. Non plural. Meaning the color you chose is going to change but not change back. Also you have to re-select your temp every time you turn it on. It will not heat up unless you do. You say 3 minutes and then it shuts off. That's incorrect. I set mine on the low setting and it's off before 2 mins is up. I timed it because I thought it was weird I could only do 1 pull before it shut off. And then there's when it heats up.. do not hold it in your hand while it's heating up. It will burn you. Not bad enough for medical attention but enough to make you drop it. In my opinion you needed to test this product before releasing it. You can say you did but facts are they don't match up to what you advertise. Such a shame too. I don't recommend. 2 stars because it does fit comfy in my hand. But functional not so much.

I could go through a whole battery trying to vape from this and still have a full chamber of browned flower. This is pretty disappointing since I've been a fan of Pulsar's 510 batteries, but I guess this isn't their field.
rows.translationZh: 只有红色档位能产生一点点蒸汽，而且味道很差。耗尽整块电池后，腔体里仍是烤褐但未充分利用的花材。作为Pulsar 510电池的老用户，这次非常失望。
rows.name: Lincoln K.

rows.title: Doesnt Work
rows.body: doesnt burn right in the chamber, just browns and lets the slightest vapor out, wont make this mistake again.
rows.translationZh: 腔体加热不正常，只把花材烤褐并产生极少蒸汽，不会再犯同样的购买错误。
rows.name: lincoln k.

rows.title: Disappointed
rows.body: I downloaded the manual and I watched YouTube videos on how to work this device bit my blinks red 4 times and shuts off. I have tried submitting a warranty but haven't heard back yet
rows.translationZh: 下载了说明书，也看了YouTube教学，但设备仍闪四次红灯后关机。已提交保修申请，尚未收到回复。
rows.name: Elicia W.

rows.title: Wowza!
rows.body: This vape has become my new best friend!
rows.name: David

rows.title: I've had mine for 3
rows.body: I've had mine for 3 days now quite satisfied with mine so far. Plan on buying more products in the near future.
rows.name: William S.

rows.title: Sad
rows.body: Received this today and right out of the box it's flashing 3 red lights and powering off. Which according to the manual is an indicator that is short circuited and needs to be replaced.
rows.translationZh: 今天收到产品，开箱即闪三次红灯并关机。按说明书，这表示短路，需要更换。
rows.name: Rita G.

rows.title: Pulsar SYNDR Dry Herb Vaporizer
rows.body: Pleasently surprised at how well this dry vape worked, easy and convenient. Easy to clean and holds the charge well. Would buy again and would recommend to others.
rows.name: Shirle

rows.title: Dry herb vaporizer
rows.body: Great product. 2 things the on and off button needs to be somewhere else. Away from charging port . Cover will not stay on. Battery doesn't stay charged long. Other than that it works great.
rows.name: Kathy C.

rows.title: Dry Herb Vaporizer
rows.body: I have a similar design and model from Strio, and I have to say that this brand of the Dry Herb Vaporizer is phenomenal, I also love the fact that they carry accessories for this device which is in my book an A Plus. I love The Pulsar version better than the Strio version
rows.name: Bobby B.

rows.title: DISAPPOINTED
rows.body: Haven't got to use it because it doesn't work. I've contacted and made a warranty claim with no response.
rows.translationZh: 完全没能使用，因为设备不工作。已经联系并提交保修申请，但没有得到回复。
rows.name: Stacey F.

rows.title: Perfect First Vaporizer
rows.body: This is my very first dry herb vaporizer and i am a noob to medical cannabis. So far this is perfect for what I wanted. Good product, works as described, fair price. Thanks
rows.name: James C.

rows.title: didnt last
rows.body: bought mine canada weekend and now its sept 20th and it quit working, it was great while it worked but only for 2.5 months with moderste use
rows.translationZh: 加拿大周末购买，到9月20日就停止工作。正常时体验很好，但中等使用强度下只维持了约两个半月。
rows.name: Butch

rows.title: Dry Herb
rows.body: Excellant
rows.name: Terry D.

rows.title: garbage
rows.body: doesnt work. used it a few times, but it takes 5+ hours to fully charge (yes im using the charger it came with, yes ive tried different power sources) and nothing. when it does charge, the light stays on and wont allow me to turn the vape on until i put the charger in and out several more times to get it to turn off. i can maybe use it twice, if im lucky, before the battery is dead. bought a second one as i thought it may be a fluke. same issue. barely any vapor, just burns up my weed. thank god i work for a dispensary so i got them for cheap, but for the love of all things holy dont buy this. did i mention it gets plastic meltingly hot while charging and using? literally melted a hole in my tabletop (crappy plastic table, but STILL) just so not worth it.
rows.translationZh: 设备基本不能正常工作。充满电需要5小时以上，充电指示灯常亮，必须反复插拔充电器才能开机；最多使用两次电池就耗尽。第二台也有相同问题。蒸汽很少，只会烤焦花材；充电和使用时热到接近熔化塑料，甚至在塑料桌面烫出洞。非常不值得购买。
rows.name: eve

rows.title: Great Vape
rows.body: I like to think of myself as a connoisseur of things and this vaporizer allows your to taste the true flavor for your enjoyment. I purchased another one to give as a gift. Great vape
rows.name: Steven M.

rows.title: Great for the price, and cool color changing!
rows.body: I have owned a Pax 3 top of the line herb vape since 2016, and I love that. The SYNDR is a quarter of the price, and works great! Only complaint I could have is that the battery doesn't last too long. Never the less it earns five stars for having great quality at a great price and it's sleek design.
rows.name: Cutter R.

rows.title: Stopped working @ 4 days!
rows.body: I wanted to give this 5 stars, but after working as expected for 4 days, it stopped working. It just flashes a red light though the battery is fully charged. I have written Pulsar twice about it snd they did not respond to either message. I would save my money and find a more dependable product.
rows.translationZh: 本来想给五星，但正常工作四天后就坏了。电池已充满却只闪红灯。两次联系Pulsar都没有回复，建议购买更可靠的产品。
rows.name: Robert C.

rows.title: Synder vaporizer dry
rows.body: Can’t give it a review because that wouldn’t be fair as I didn’t get to use it just one session out of it before it Died RIP
rows.translationZh: 只使用了一个循环便彻底失效，因此无法公平评价。
rows.name: Virgil N.

rows.title: Amazing
rows.body: I am new to these things and I am very happy with my choice. Basically it's exactly what I was looking for as a newbie
rows.name: Vincent N.

rows.title: No smoke
rows.body: Very hard to draw on. No smoke on red settings. Not happy. I’ve had a pulsar barb flower for over a year and love it. Wished I’d bought another one. Just looking for something smaller and more discreet.
rows.translationZh: 吸阻很大，红色档位也没有蒸汽。很不满意。我用了Pulsar Barb Flower一年多且很喜欢，只是想换一款更小、更隐蔽的产品。
rows.name: ct

rows.title: Snydr - loved it but lasted only a few weeks
rows.body: I loved this for quick sessions in the garden, but it died after a few weeks. After a couple puffs on any settling, it flashes red and turns off.
rows.translationZh: 很喜欢用它在花园里快速使用，但几周后就坏了。无论哪个档位，吸几口后都会闪红灯并关机。
rows.name: Laurie S.

rows.title: Wouldn't pull, doesn't work at all
rows.body: Tried reaching out, haven't heard back yet but it doesn't pull at all. Save your money for something that works.
rows.translationZh: 完全无法抽吸，设备不能工作。已经尝试联系但尚未得到回复，建议把钱留给真正能工作的产品。
rows.name: Jennifer D.

rows.title: I was hopeful
rows.body: Hopes smashed. Finally arrived and doesn't work. Getting the vibration and red light. Never any other lights. Doesn't seem to heat up.
rows.translationZh: 原本很期待，但到货后不能工作。只有震动和红灯，没有其他灯光，也似乎不加热。
rows.name: Bambi

rows.title: Can’t figure it out
rows.body: I got the device, charged it and loaded it. Turn it on and nothing happens. No heat up process or maybe I’m doing it wrong. Can’t get it to pull anything at all
rows.name: Miranda N.

rows.title: Don't buy
rows.body: The bottom tray falls off.
rows.translationZh: 底部托盘会脱落。
rows.name: Christina B.

rows.title: Terrible Product, Terrible Support
rows.body: I purchased this product and followed the directions exactly. All I got was some burnt herb. There is no air flow, it does not create vapor, and the battery dies after just a handful of uses. It takes forever to charge and can not be used while charging. It is absolutely worthless. I sent a message to support on the 4th of July. I waited through the holiday, and I waited through the weekend. I waited all day Monday and still nothing. This is not a company I will be doing business with again.
rows.translationZh: 严格按说明操作后只得到烤焦花材。没有气流、不产生蒸汽，电池只能使用很少几次；充电时间很长，而且充电时不能使用。7月4日联系支持，等过假期、周末和周一仍没有回复，因此不愿再与这家公司交易。
rows.name: Cade

rows.title: Great divorce for the price
rows.body:
I own a pax which does work better over all but has its down sides in size and price while on the other hand this divide is compact has a fair battery life for its size and is quick at heating and doesn’t burn your flower unless you over pack it or run it to many times with out cleaning (20-25 sessions before I noticed any burnt taste and was fix right after cleaning) 

Only down sides I see with the device is the button layout it should just be the same as 510 thread batts there was no need to make it complex holding and clicking mix and match
rows.name: Carson p.

rows.title: No vapor
rows.body: This doesn't really create vape. It's very hard to pull air through it.
rows.translationZh: 几乎不产生蒸汽，空气很难吸入。
rows.name: Sirena

rows.title: Wonderful
rows.body: No problems at all
rows.name: andrew b.

rows.title: smooth
rows.body: This vaporizer is sleek and smooth making every session an enjoyable experience.
rows.name: Steven

rows.title: No vapor
rows.body: It heated up, turned pink, flower turned brown...no vapor
rows.translationZh: 设备加热、变成粉色，花材也变褐，但没有蒸汽。
rows.name: Penny

rows.title: My first vape and I'm so pleased I bought a second one
rows.body: I didn't find a lot of information online about these and I knew the Pulsar brand from their 510 cart battery units. Loading and using it was very straightforward for a newbie like me. I used it for a week or so & decided to buy another one in case I lost this one. Very happy with it!
rows.name: Andy

rows.title: I love it
rows.body: Awesome vaporizer. :+1:
rows.name: Monica N.

rows.title: Syndr
rows.body: The syndr is no good it's doesn't heat the flower enough ..On the hotest setting I can take the used flower out and still smoke it in a pipe .
rows.translationZh: SYNDR不够好，花材加热不足。即使使用最高档，取出的花材仍可以放进烟斗继续使用。
rows.name: Duke

rows.title: No Vape
rows.body: Turns pink but no haptic signal and hard to draw. I think the instructions are incorr3ct. If I hold the button then I get the haptic signal but now always recharging and again no draw
rows.translationZh: 设备会变成粉色，但没有震动提示，而且很难抽吸。我认为说明书可能不正确；长按按钮后会有震动，但总要重新充电，仍然抽不动。
rows.name: Susan G.

rows.title: Extreme dissatisfaction but looks cool
rows.body: A medical patient in an immense amount of pain wasted a ton of money on this today. Please save your money
rows.translationZh: 一名承受剧烈疼痛的医疗用户今天在这款产品上浪费了很多钱。虽然外观不错，但请节省这笔钱。
rows.name: Carissa K.

rows.title: Does not produce vapor.
rows.body:
Gets hot enough to roast your weed, but there is no vapor production. It’s like there is no airflow. I’ve tried everything. Hopefully customer service can help. 

In the meantime… save your money.
rows.translationZh: 温度足以烤熟花材，却完全没有蒸汽，像是没有气流。我已经尝试所有方法，希望客服能提供帮助；在此之前建议不要购买。
rows.name: David H.

rows.title: Herb vaporizer
rows.body: Didn’t like it make made it taste bad
rows.translationZh: 不喜欢这款产品，它让味道变得很差。
rows.name: Reanne M.

rows.title: disappointed
rows.body: it is hard to turn on, heat up, get it to draw.
rows.name: T R.

rows.title: Game Changer
rows.body: I absolutely love this vape! Easy to use, clean, effective, discreet and sooooo cute.
rows.name: Shelly M.

rows.title: GREAT AFFORDABLE VAPE
rows.body: I'm a long time customer. After investigating vaping, I decided to give Pulsar a try. And I'm soooo glad I did. I have three of the APX series, two Range ( which has been discontinued) and now the SYNDR. And again, BRAVO. It gives good extraction on the Blue setting. Plus it doesn't roast the herb like the Red setting. That setting gives heavy clouds. AND, they have a great customer service crew. I ordered a rolling tray w/lid the other day. The website didn't add the 10% discount for signing up for email. I sent a message, before they shipped it, and I was very pleasantly surprised when I opened the package & they included a one of thier huge tapestries. VERY VERY COOL. Can't wait to see what they come up with next.
rows.name: walter h.

rows.title: Broke 1st day
rows.body: When turned on it just blinks red and turns off. Have had it for 6 hours
rows.translationZh: 开机后只闪红灯并关机，拿到手六小时内就坏了。
rows.name: Sean

rows.title: Love it
rows.body: Love it
rows.name: Dianne S.

rows.title: It doesn’t hit very strong
rows.body: It doesn’t hit very strong at all
rows.translationZh: 吸入强度非常弱。
rows.name: Cassie D.

rows.title: Did not work
rows.body: Dont get up to temp
rows.translationZh: 达不到所需温度。
rows.name: John D.

rows.title: Love It
rows.body: Good quality, easy to clean, and I love the color-changing aspect! Fave vape.
rows.name: Victoria C.

rows.body: This is the coolest product! I love it so much. It works so good and it's so convenient. The quality is amazing. I can't recommend it enough! Plus it's a really great price. Buy one for you and a friend!
rows.name: Taylor D.

rows.body: I wouldn’t recommend this product. Within the first 2 weeks, the dry herb atomizer stopped connecting. Within less than a month, the internal battery unit started trying to come out when I unscrewed the atomizer after I was kindly given a replacement. There was also something gross in my wax atomizer that I have yet to use. Even the packaging is terrible, and unusable upon opening. Your money is better spent elsewhere
rows.translationZh: 不推荐这款产品。使用不到两周，干草雾化器就无法连接；更换后不到一个月，拧下雾化器时内部电池组件也开始被带出。尚未使用的蜡雾化器内还有不明污物。包装开箱后也无法正常使用，这笔钱更适合花在别处。
rows.name: Anonymous

rows.body: This vape is amazing, and its discreet and is made high quality.
rows.name: Dylan V.

rows.body: I haven’t used a flower vape since I lost my PAX 6 years ago, so I will say there’s probably some user error. My BIGGEST complaint is that the casing sucks. The outside is boxy tin, and the inside is foam that for some reason had paper stuck to it that peeled easily to reveal a sticky underneath. I had to take the foam out completely, and likely won’t use the casing which is unfortunate. On my first use, this product is super nice, but has a bit of a learning curve to properly heating the flower, so I’m not always hitting when I’m trying to.
rows.name: Anonymous

rows.body: The dry herb atomizer works great. The wax atomizer I was only able to get working once. Now it refuses to recognize it.
rows.name: Anonymous

rows.body: I've had my delta for a couple months now. When I first received it, everything worked make a charm. Now a couple months into use, my battery light is stuck on red rather than green when turning on and off. Not sure what difference it makes or if it means anything. Carts work seamlessly and dont leak on low voltage. I will say the dry herb attachment seems to really drain the battery, which takes ages to charge. Not sure if its user error, but I do enjoy it!
rows.name: TheCov3N

rows.body: I don’t know if i have a defective unit but if i switch to the ceramic wax atomizer the battery does not recognize it. I have to play with it loosely. I mean, i can’t **** it tight. It leaves a small gap from the battery and the atomizer for it to work.
rows.translationZh: 不确定是否拿到次品。切换到陶瓷蜡雾化器时，电池无法识别；不能完全拧紧，必须松动并在电池与雾化器之间留出小缝才能工作。
rows.name: Mr. W.

rows.body: My device does not work. I push the button 5 times like directed and it lights up but a couple seconds later turns right off. Very disappointed
rows.translationZh: 设备不能工作。按说明连续按键五次后会亮灯，但几秒后立即关机，非常失望。
rows.name: Julie L.

rows.body: Enjoy the product!
rows.name: Dannielle S.

rows.body: as advertised plus! highly user friendly hughky recommended… highly
rows.name: TheWilliam M.I.

rows.body: I had to submit a claim for my device bc it stopped working after just a few days.
rows.translationZh: 设备使用几天后就停止工作，我不得不提交售后申请。
rows.name: Monika G.

rows.body: Worked great through the first charge,but after recharging the battery only workd with the dry herb attachment. When attempting to activate it , it just flashes white 3 times and soes not heat up. Have started the warranty process and am awaiting the results.
rows.name: Richard C.

rows.body: Haven't tried all the settings yet.  Ask me later
rows.name: Anjenette H.

rows.body: This "tool" opens up a whole new realm of things to try. It works on dry herb, wax / dab concentrates and it can be used for 510 cartridges but a dedicated 510 battery is probably more convienient for that. A home run in every way, great products, excellent customer service and multiple payment options.
rows.name: J D.J.

rows.body: Great tool I now own 4. I just love variety. Great lil tool. Love this and it’s versatile.
rows.name: Janet B.

rows.body: Works great, no complaints so far!
rows.name: Jeremy M.

rows.body: Works much better than my previous device, so far it seems to be well worth it.
rows.name: Anonymous

rows.body: First 3 times I used for flower and it worked good.  On 4th try no haptic feedback and all it does is blink white 3 times and go off.  Absolute complete waste of money.
rows.translationZh: 前三次用于花材时工作正常，第四次开始没有震动反馈，只会白灯闪三次后关机，完全浪费钱。
rows.name: Craig

rows.body: Just received received mines and only used it’s twice and just keeps blinking white ,help I’m not sure what wrong with it
rows.translationZh: 刚收到设备，只用了两次就一直闪白灯。不确定哪里出了问题，希望得到帮助。
rows.name: Dafunkbaby

rows.body: I recently purchased the pulsar delta 3 in 1 and everything was great except the dry herb atomizer. I contacted pulsar via email mail and within minutes I had a response saying they would send me a whole new kit . Which showed up in about a weeks time. They also included some other really good stuff because they want it right. .the customer service is top notch the new one works amazing and I am going to check out their other products this works really good and I believe in supporting a company who takes care of their customers on that level
rows.name: Chad

rows.body: Stopped working during 1st use
rows.translationZh: 第一次使用过程中就停止工作。
rows.name: Joel J.

rows.body:
Severely burned my mouth using the concentrate coil: there’s so little headspace between the mouthpiece and the coil base, it’s ridiculously easy to suck up molten resin when inhaling.  

The silicone concentrate coil cap fits ok when its cold, but after a few back to back sessions it heats up, expands and resin starts leaking down the base.

The recharging port being in the bottom vs the side is terribly inconvenient, especially when you need to recharge with hot resin still in the coil. 

Haven’t tried the dry herb attachment yet.  Overall, it’s not nearly as nice as my Pulsar 510 Digital.  Very disappointed, given the price.
rows.translationZh: 使用浓缩物线圈时口腔被严重烫伤：吸嘴与线圈底座间距太小，吸入时很容易把熔融树脂带入口中。硅胶线圈盖冷态下尚可，但连续使用后受热膨胀，树脂会沿底座泄漏。底部充电口也很不方便，尤其在线圈内仍有热树脂时。尚未测试干草附件；以该价格而言，整体明显不如Pulsar 510 Digital。
rows.name: James

rows.body: At first I was excited to have a pen I could load a dab into or pack with flower on the go, the recommended portions seem to be spot on but over the last 3 months of every other day use usually the pen has become very inconsistent, unreliable, and unpredictable. Using the flower atomizer with about .3 G or less sometimes the flower doesn't burn so you're left hitting it 2-3 times before any smoke and sometimes a BIG hit comes from the smallest first pull, it dies quickly being able to use the pen as a light hitter 10-15 times before it's dead which for me is 1 "bowl" of flower or 5 dabs, the dab atomizer has gotten to a point where the preheat doesn't heat enough to smoke but gets hot to the touch, I use dead center settings for temperature and think this would be a great pen for somebody who doesn't have very high expectations, I got mine for 80.00 at a dispensary. :(
rows.translationZh: 最初很期待能随身使用花材和浓缩物，但隔日使用约三个月后，设备变得非常不稳定且不可预测。花材雾化器有时需要吸两三次才有输出，有时轻吸却突然产生很大一口；续航只能支持约10至15次轻吸，相当于一碗花材或约5次浓缩物。浓缩物雾化器的预热不足以产生蒸汽，外壳却会变得烫手。
rows.name: Anonymous

rows.body: Well, this is my third time buying the product.I love the look.I love the idea , but it just doesn't work.  A.\n Ceramic bull broke within a couple days. Looks like it melted through or something. This product needs a rehaul on the design.  And might stand a chance with better material.Especially the ceramic bowl
rows.translationZh: 这是第三次购买。我喜欢外观和产品理念，但它就是不能可靠工作。陶瓷碗几天内就损坏，看起来像被熔穿。产品需要重新设计并使用更好的材料，尤其是陶瓷碗。
rows.name: Donn L.

rows.body: Loving it
rows.name: Janice H.

rows.body: Broken already not even 24 hours do not buy the delta
rows.translationZh: 不到24小时就坏了，不建议购买Delta。
rows.name: chris h.

rows.body: El producto es 100% bueno puedes fumar en todos lados con este producto pero me ocurrió el problema más común dejo de funcionar no me lee los atomizadores ya los limpie y todo pero aun así no funciona.
rows.name: Anonymous

rows.body: It was good but it was to small
rows.name: Shelia B.

rows.body: I used the dry herb attachment 2x before it decided to no longer be recognized by the battery. The wax function is temperamental AT BEST. Please do not waste your moneys. Believe the issues customers list here- I’ve had em alll.
rows.translationZh: 干草附件只用了两次，电池就不再识别；蜡功能的表现充其量也只是时好时坏。请不要浪费钱，其他用户列出的那些问题我几乎都遇到了。
rows.name: Jordan J.

rows.body:
I got the Pulsar Delta 3 in 1.

Dry herb chamber works but the wax chamber never functioned. I took it back to point of sale (Bobs HQ) they told me to contact the manufacturer.
rows.translationZh: 购买了Pulsar Delta 3-in-1。干草仓可以工作，但蜡仓从未正常工作。退回销售点后，对方要求直接联系制造商。
rows.name: Anonymous

rows.body: I got one dry herb session, then the device stopped recognizing the dry herb fitting, making it unusable. Very disappointing for a new device.
rows.translationZh: 干草模式只完成一次使用，之后设备便不再识别干草附件，整机无法使用。新设备出现这种情况令人失望。
rows.name: Anonymous

rows.body:
My 2nd review- I've been dabbing from that amazing bucket for months now (you charge it every day if you dab for three hours straight like me) and it lost it's steam.... I was needing the red setting (high) for barely any clouds. Oh dear. This is my favorite bucket. I put a cartridge into the rig and it worked great. OK, not the machine. I cleaned out the threads on both ends really well (there was no visible gunk or residue) and it works LIKE NEW AGAIN. (I'm still coughing a day later)

CLEAN YOUR THREADS.

rows.title: A SOLID OPTION FOR ALL THREE NEEDS!
rows.body:
I sure didn't need any new weed toys, but here we are. I actually liked the idea of all 3 in one, even flower- which I don't smoke much anymore (hey- it comes prerolled and infused now!) But I love this!

One hitch- my dab piece didn't work at first, there was DUST in the threads, Just a head's up. Clean it out and re-attach.

Everything hits AMAZING! The dabs burn clean, the bucket is AMAZING and smooth- will be easy to clean. The herb burns nicely! and carts are just as expected. Overall, a bit on the pricey side- if you don't have all these options in other toys- this is a solid purchase. The best dabbing bucket Pulsar has made too! However, it seems the dabbing option ONLY has a preheat sesh- no button on demand- and that is a bummer to me. The green is too weak, the blue too hot. But the burn is so good and clean, worth it. This is my only electric vape for flower, so I'm having fun! Recommended!
